pictures.title: Attack
pictures.metaphor: TWO broad straight swords CROSSED in one bold X, points up to the upper left and upper right: thick ivory-steel blades with a soft bevel down each blade, chunky slate crossguards, warm ochre wooden grips and round pommels at the bottom. Both swords equally large, identical and clearly separate where they cross. Plain blades, no engraving, no shield, no crest, no blood. Reads instantly as attack / fight.

pictures.title: Target
pictures.metaphor: ONE large muted-teal pawn silhouette standing at the center, held inside a bold deep-crimson TARGET RETICLE: one thick crimson ring around the pawn with four thick crimson triangular pointers on the ring at 12, 3, 6 and 9 o'clock aimed INWARD at the pawn. Nothing outside the ring: no corner brackets, no frame, no viewfinder marks. The pawn fills most of the ring's inside with a clear dark gap between pawn and pointers. Perfectly symmetric; chunky shapes, no thin crosshair hairlines, no bullseye stripes, no arrow. Reads as: this piece is marked as the target being aimed at.
